title: Convert web application to Progressive Web App (PWA)

requirements.text: Enhance PWA manifest to enable full app installation experience with complete metadata including name, short_name, description, start_url, display mode set to 'standalone', orientation preferences, and comprehensive icon set covering all required sizes (192x192, 512x512, maskable variants)
acceptanceCriteria: PWA manifest includes all required fields for app installation
App can be installed on mobile devices and desktop browsers
App displays in standalone mode without browser UI when launched
App icons appear correctly on home screen and app drawer

requirements.text: Upgrade service worker implementation to support full offline functionality with advanced caching strategies, background sync for data mutations when offline, and cache versioning for proper update management
acceptanceCriteria: App loads and displays cached content when offline
User actions made offline are queued and sync when connection restored
Service worker updates cleanly without leaving stale caches
Users see appropriate offline status indicators

requirements.text: Add iOS-specific meta tags and configurations for optimal installation experience on iOS devices including apple-mobile-web-app-capable, apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style, and apple-touch-startup-image for splash screens
acceptanceCriteria: App can be added to iOS home screen with proper icon
App launches in fullscreen mode on iOS without Safari UI
Status bar styling matches app theme on iOS
Splash screen displays during app launch on iOS

requirements.text: Implement app-like navigation patterns with native-feeling transitions, gesture support for back navigation, and proper handling of hardware back button on Android devices
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation feels smooth with app-like transitions
Swipe gestures work for appropriate navigation actions
Android hardware back button functions correctly
Navigation history is preserved across app restarts

requirements.text: Add install prompt functionality that detects when the app is installable and presents a custom in-app installation banner with clear call-to-action for users to add the app to their device
acceptanceCriteria: Install banner appears when app meets PWA criteria
Users can dismiss or trigger installation from banner
Banner respects user preferences and doesn't reappear if dismissed
Installation success is tracked and banner hidden after install

requirements.text: Optimize app performance for mobile devices including lazy loading routes, image optimization, reducing bundle size, and implementing proper loading states for slow connections
acceptanceCriteria: Initial load time is under 3 seconds on 3G connection
Routes load on-demand rather than upfront
Images are properly compressed and use responsive formats
Loading indicators appear for operations taking >300ms

requirements.text: Implement responsive design improvements to ensure the app feels native on all screen sizes from small phones to tablets, with touch-optimized tap targets (minimum 44x44px) and appropriate spacing
acceptanceCriteria: All interactive elements meet minimum touch target size
Layout adapts smoothly across device sizes
No horizontal scrolling on any device
Text remains readable without zooming on all devices

constraints: Must maintain existing functionality and user data
Must work with current Internet Identity authentication
Must support both light and dark mode themes
Must preserve existing backend actor implementation
nonGoals: Native iOS or Android app development

required: App icon in 192x192 resolution with transparent background suitable for all platforms (app-icon-192.dim_192x192.png)
App icon in 512x512 resolution with transparent background for high-res displays (app-icon-512.dim_512x512.png)
Maskable app icon in 512x512 resolution with safe zone padding for Android adaptive icons (app-icon-maskable.dim_512x512.png)
iOS splash screen for iPhone portrait orientation showing app branding (splash-iphone.dim_750x1334.png)
iOS splash screen for iPad portrait orientation showing app branding (splash-ipad.dim_1536x2048.png)
